facts.text: Despayre, originally known as Horuz, was a planet in the Horuz system in the Outer Rim Territories, that served as a massive penal and slave world for the Galactic Empire and as a location where the first Death Star was constructed and completed, after being relocated many times to avoid Alliance...

facts.text: The shipyard that created the Galactic Empire's ultimate weapon became the center of the Imperial war machine when construction was moved from Geonosis to Despayre.

evidence.section: History > Construction of the First Death Star

facts.text: Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin visited the system on many occasions to oversee the construction, bringing with him Imperial enslaved Wookiees from Kashyyyk of the Kashyyyk system, shortly after the Empire's formation.

facts.text: The landmass was mostly covered in jungle, and the planet was home to an abundance of species.

facts.text: The planet had a low gravity of less than 0.75 standard gravity and an erratic orbit which created tidal forces that set the conditions for harsh seasonal gales.

evidence.quote: The planet had a low gravity of less than 0.75 standard gravity and an erratic orbit which created tidal forces that set the conditions for harsh seasonal gales.

facts.text: The jungle flora responded to this environmental challenge by producing large, close-knit growths that stabbed roots deep into the ground, creating completely impenetrable patches of rain forest in some places.

facts.text: Species representative of the animal life on Despayre include poisonous crustaceans, small winged lizards and a manta-like creature that had an interesting life cycle that began in the ocean and ended in the jungle.

evidence.quote: Species representative of the animal life on Despayre include poisonous crustaceans, small winged lizards and a manta-like creature that had an interesting life cycle that began in the ocean and ended in the jungle.
